  "situation": "The Court is reviewing proposed acquisitions under the Section 702 2021 Certification. Section 702(a) authorizes the Attorney General and the Director of National Intelligence to jointly authorize, for up to one year, targeting people reasonably believed to be outside the United States to acquire foreign intelligence information. Section 702(b) sets limits on who may be targeted, certain communications that may be intentionally acquired, and Fourth Amendment consistency. A certification must attest that the acquisition involves obtaining foreign intelligence information from or with the assistance of an electronic communication service provider. Section 702(f) establishes querying procedures for information collected under an authorization, including protections related to United States-person queries. Amicus contends that provisions concerning providers, queries, and legislative history support a narrower reading of what acquisitions Section 702 permits.",
